name: Алексий Васильев Иванов — the 1885 Samara "son Павел" hint is a false match
researcher_question: What children did Алексий Васильев Иванов of Samara, husband of Елизавета Васильева and father of Виктор (born 29 October 1894) and Павел (born 15 February 1902), have besides these two?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 22, hint-samples.csv row 758, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-22 as a FALSE MATCH: the hinted 1885 Samara birth of Павел Иванов (ark:/61903/1:1:6V7Y-N9KZ) names the parents as Василий Иванов and Степанида Иванова, peasants of Sarbon village — not the subject Алексей Васильевич Иванов and Елизавета of Samara. The decisive check was the register page image (ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G99H-SF57), which shows the father's given name written 'Василій' (not a mis-indexed patronymic for 'Алексей Васильев') and the page header 'на 1885й годъ' (confirming the indexed 1885 date against the artifact's spurious 1871-1875 coverage); hence image_basis true. Image reading licensed by calibration against two other indexed same-page entries (6V7Y-N9KQ, 6V7Y-N9VJ). See README 'Notes for reviewers'.
